summary: Design governed, observable multi-agent AI workflows across enterprise operations. Review architecture controls and build a practical implementation roadmap.
lede: Multi-agent AI architecture training helps product managers, architects, engineers, and automation leads design governed workflows. Learners map agent responsibilities and trust boundaries, define tool permissions and human escalation, model workflow threats, and plan telemetry, recovery, and accountable review. Practical exercises develop architecture diagrams, control matrices, observability plans, and an implementation roadmap; model evaluation and production deployment controls receive operational or conceptual treatment, not deployment-level implementation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, build, govern, or operate AI agents across connected enterprise workflows. It suits experienced practitioners with responsibility for system design or automation decisions.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of software architecture, AI-enabled workflows, and enterprise operations is expected. Prior experience designing or managing software systems is recommended. Programming is not required for course completion; exercises focus on architecture diagrams, control artefacts, and scenario analysis.
